name: Ptolemy Achebe-Magnússon
role: Underground filmmaker and VR experience designer
location: The Loft, Lockhaven North — operates a pirate screening venue called the Sediment, near Fullerton and Damen
description:
Ptolemy is a heavyset man in his mid-forties with dark brown skin, a close-cropped beard going silver at the jaw, and the slightly unfocused look of someone who is always composing shots in their peripheral vision. He has a prosthetic left eye — not an elegant chrome implant but a visually obvious thing, matte black with a ring of amber light around the iris, which he has never had cosmetically upgraded because he likes that it makes people aware they may be recorded. He wears the same rotating set of worn high-collared coats regardless of season. He carries a battered intake recorder everywhere and the habit of pulling it out in the middle of conversations has ended several relationships.

His films are long, structurally experimental, and deeply uncomfortable — documentary and fiction entangled in ways the viewer cannot always disentangle. He is most famous for a six-hour VR experience called 'Debt Architecture' that maps a single GLMZ family's financial obligations across four generations as a navigable spatial environment, placing the viewer inside the abstract structure of inherited poverty. It has been downloaded illegally over 400,000 times and banned by three corponations. He funds himself through occasional commercial VR work he takes under a pseudonym and despises himself for.

core_fears: That observation is just another form of extraction and his entire practice is predatory
That the films change nothing and the suffering he documents continues undisturbed
core_desires: To make something so undeniably true that it cannot be ignored or reframed
To be told, once, by someone whose life he filmed that it was worth it
coping_mechanisms: Framing everything as material — distance through the lens
Intellectual argument as a substitute for emotional processing
blind_spots: Treats the subjects of his films as having implicitly consented to his interpretation of them
Does not recognize his own hunger for recognition as the primary fuel for much of his political righteousness
psychology.secret: The family documented in 'Debt Architecture' — his most celebrated work — never gave full informed consent. His cousin helped arrange access under false pretenses. The family has since fragmented and one member, who recognized herself in the piece, has spent years trying to identify the filmmaker.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Dense theoretical vocabulary that he switches off entirely when charming strangers into being filmed; can sound like two different people
speech_patterns.cadence: Discursive and circling when theorizing; abrupt and direct when asking something he actually wants
verbal_tics: 'Can I ask you something?' as preamble to something he will ask regardless of the answer
Long humming pauses before sentences that turn out to be important
example_lines: 'I don't tell stories. I excavate weight. There's a difference — stories have shapes. Weight just sits there.'
'I'll ask you one question and I'll never tell anyone who answered it. You can lie if you need to. I just need to hear the shape of the answer.'

story_hooks: Somewhere in his archive is footage of an event that multiple powerful parties would pay or threaten to suppress — he does not know it yet but people who do are already looking for him
The family member from 'Debt Architecture' has finally tracked him down, and their first contact is either a lawsuit, a threat, or something more complex
narrative_function: Archive and witness — Ptolemy has been filming GLMZ's civilian underbelly for twenty years and his raw footage is a trove of faces, places, and events; he can provide documentary evidence, historical context, or connections to anyone he has ever pointed a lens at
augmentations: Prosthetic left eye (matte black, amber-ring, recording-capable); nicotine-metabolizer implant (occupational stress management)
daily_life: Mornings spent reviewing footage and editing in a cramped Lockhaven North apartment, afternoons at the Sediment managing screenings or arguing with collaborators, evenings often spent in Pilsen Veil or Mexicantown Libre gathering material.
affiliation: Independent; Sediment underground screening collective; occasional grey-market distribution through Depth Markers network

decision_rules: Always keep a copy of everything in at least three locations
Never agree to destroy footage — you can agree to not release it, but never agree to destroy it
escalation_ladder: Transparent acknowledgment that he is deflecting, as a disarming tactic
Genuine retreat — he is not physically brave and knows it

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Curious, warm, visibly interested in their specific life — this is genuine and also always partly professional
interpersonal_modes.friends: Demanding in the way only people with high standards can be; shows affection through blunt honesty

stress_responses.low: Throws himself into editing, emerges with new material
stress_responses.medium: Becomes verbosely theoretical in conversation, a sign he is avoiding something specific
stress_responses.high: Takes the recorder out and starts filming as a dissociative response to crisis

contradictions: Believes deeply in the right to privacy while spending his career systematically breaching it
habits: Introduces himself by his full name to everyone, always
breaking_points: Being told his work is exploitative by someone he respects

timeline.event: Born in Lockhaven North to a Nigerian-Icelandic father and a Ghanaian-Mongolian mother
Lost left eye in a Ferrogate Transit station incident during a protest he was filming; chose a functional prosthetic over cosmetic replacement
'Debt Architecture' released through grey-market distribution; immediate ban by Axiom, Sterling-Nakamura, and Zheng-Dao
Founded the Sediment screening collective in Lockhaven North

related_entities: Zheng-Dao Heavy Industries Containment Foam Launcher CFL-2 'Amber'

physical_description.build: Heavyset with a barrel chest and thick shoulders, slightly soft around the midsection but broad-framed — the build of someone who has spent decades sitting in editing chairs and standing in darkened rooms rather than moving through the world.
physical_description.hair_style: Close-cropped, neatly trimmed but never fussy
physical_description.eye_color: Right eye: dark brown, natural; left eye: matte black prosthetic with amber ring-light iris
physical_description.complexion: Weathered face with pronounced laugh lines and forehead creases from decades of squinting at monitors. Close-cropped beard salt-and-peppered at the jawline, kept meticulously groomed — the one vanity he allows himself. Slight permanent furrow between brows from concentration.
distinguishing_marks: Matte black prosthetic left eye with amber light-ring around iris, visibly non-cosmetic and deliberately maintained to appear obviously artificial.
Faint cigarette burn scar on inside of left wrist from a 2189 studio accident, barely visible unless pointed out.
Fine webbing of scar tissue across knuckles of both hands from a Tier-5 altercation in Mexicantown in 2201 — he doesn't talk about it.
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Prosthetic left eye (matte black with amber iris-ring, recording-capable), obviously non-cosmetic and maintained in deliberate non-stealth configuration. Nicotine-metabolizer implant is subcutaneous and invisible.
physical_description.posture_movement: Stands with slight forward lean, shoulders hunched as if perpetually framing a shot through his hands. Moves deliberately but without haste, economical gestures. Has the habit of turning slightly to one side in conversation to position his prosthetic eye toward the speaker — a tell that he is recording audio. Eyes rarely settle on one point; constantly scanning, assessing light and shadow.
physical_description.clothing_style: Rotates between three or four high-collared long coats (charcoal, dark brown, navy) regardless of season — vintage synthweave from the 2190s, cut loose and worn soft. Under them: plain black or grey long-sleeve shirts, often stained with coffee or solder flux. Worn Tier-4 workboots resoled multiple times. A faded canvas satchel across his chest containing his intake recorder, lens caps, and worn notebooks. No jewelry. His clothes smell like old film stock and cigarette smoke despite nicotine-metabolizer implant — ghost of a habit.

image_prompt: Heavyset 44-year-old Black man with West African features and Icelandic heritage, dark brown skin, close-cropped salt-and-pepper beard, wearing a worn high-collared charcoal synthweave coat over plain black shirt. Left eye is a matte black prosthetic with bright amber LED ring-light iris — visibly artificial and intimidating, recording-capable. Right eye dark brown, natural. Tired, weathered expression of someone who has spent decades in darkened rooms.
